Direct transfer modes. Direct transfer can post in one go or create separate shipment and receipt documents. Ship and receipt mode supports partial shipping and warehouse shipment. transfer-orders warehouse posting

Multiple scheduled PTE installs and cancel. Several future installs can be scheduled for the same PTE, for example one version on the next minor and another on the next major update. Scheduled installs show on the app details page and can be canceled before they run. admin pte scheduling updates

Test handlers. Test handlers provide setup and tear down in AL, with hooks before and after the test codeunit, test procedure and each data-driven test case. The demo uses a logger handler that traces while tests run. al testing test-handlers interfaces setup

Tax area code and tax liable on Shopify orders and refunds. Shopify orders get tax area code and tax liable fields, filled from Shopify or by AI and used when the sales document is created, and they can be overridden to skip standard mapping. The Shopify refund page gets a tax fact box and tax lines. shopify tax refunds orders ai ux

Auto create B2B catalog. The toggle creates a catalog linked to the company location so Business Central prices apply. Market catalogs are an alternative for simpler plans. shopify b2b catalogs pricing markets

Composite layouts. The old all-in-one report layout is split into a body layout for structure, a theme for look and feel, and a header footer layout. Theme and header footer are applied at runtime, so the same report can be run in different ways. reporting layouts word branding

IsDirty on Record and RecordRef. A new IsDirty method on Record and RecordRef tests whether a record has changed. It lets you ask the user to save without comparing fields by hand. al record recordref ux

Subcontracting purchase order lines. The generated purchase order holds lines for vendor-supplied components, the routing operation, an info line and comment lines with instructions. subcontracting purchase-order comments manufacturing

Item charges on subcontracting receipts. Item charges can be assigned to posted subcontracting receipt lines, including the operation line. Production order statistics show the charge in subcontractor cost. subcontracting costing item-charges manufacturing finance

Install Subcontracting app from Manufacturing Setup. The app can be installed from Manufacturing Setup when disabling legacy subcontracting. Without legacy data no migration runs. installation setup migration manufacturing

Component supply method on BOM lines. A field on production BOM lines sets how a component reaches the subcontractor: transfer, consignment at vendor, or vendor supplied. subcontracting bom components manufacturing

Released production orders from planning worksheet. Carrying out action messages can create production orders as released, or released and print. Flushing posts consumption and capacity on creation. manufacturing planning production-orders ux

Cross-environment master data management. Subsidiaries in other environments of the same tenant can pull master data from the HQ company. It is built in, with no middleware or custom code, and uses the same UI as same-environment synchronization. mdm cross-environment integration admin localization entra

Flagged and compliant policy statuses. Reports and lines show compliant or flagged, with AI reasoning beside flagged expenses. Missing receipt info also flags a line. expense policies ux agents approval

Table extensions stored on base table. Table extension fields are stored on the base table, so no join is needed. Reads are faster and writes up to 30% faster in a benchmark. database performance table-extensions al

Expense Agent mobile app. A new mobile app for iOS and Android scans receipts, crops the background and works offline. Users accept beta conditions and need a Business Central environment that supports the Expense Agent. expense mobile preview admin ux

Report inbox APIs. New APIs cover the report inbox operations, where scheduled reports and report packs land. Agents and automation can use them to trigger processing or AI analysis, through Power Platform, an MCP server, Copilot Studio or any API client. api report-inbox mcp power-platform reporting agents

Created by and modified by full name system fields. New system fields hold the created by and modified by full names next to the user ids. They can be placed on pages in code and through personalization or customization. al system-fields personalization ux

Subcontracting app. The Subcontracting app, released in minor update three, is pre-installed on new environments. It extends the older subcontracting that only registered that the work happened. subcontracting manufacturing app supply-chain

Company tax registration ID and country extensions. Tax registration IDs are now populated when creating customers. Small Belgium and US extensions are added, and Belgium adds an Enterprise number option. shopify vat belgium us extensions admin

Subcontracting with warehouse receipt. For directed put-away locations, a subcontracting order needs a warehouse receipt. Put-away with serial numbers is created only for the last operation, otherwise output is registered. subcontracting warehouse item-tracking manufacturing

Index management access. The index management page can be found through Tell Me, including semantic search, and through a Manage indexes button on table information. Indexes, including SIFT indexes, can be disabled there. database indexes admin ux

Review and approve tax match. A review window shows the tax area, jurisdictions and taxes per shipping and product line. A red icon marks low confidence and the user approves or cancels. shopify ai tax ux
Power BI apps on Fabric. The Power BI apps were converted to the Fabric backend. They will come as samples or on AppSource in single- and multi-company versions. power-bi fabric reporting appsource

Subcontracting details fact box on routing. A fact box on production order routing shows whether a line is subcontracted, connected components and the WIP quantity at the subcontractor. It drills down to WIP ledger entries and links purchase, transfer and production orders. subcontracting routing factbox wip ux manufacturing

Business Central MCP server as data access layer. Copilot gets Business Central data through the same MCP server used for agentic integration. It reaches all tables, including extensions, without custom APIs. mcp copilot extensions api

Presubmission policy check. Submitters can run the AI policy check manually with a check policies button before sending the report. It is not automatic for submitters and can be turned off to save AI credits. expense ai policies ux approvals copilot agents end-user

Business Central data questions. Copilot searches Business Central data with the user's context, permissions and company, for example most urgent sales orders. It also analyzes sales data, such as the least sold items, and suggests actions. copilot sales data reporting chat permissions

Follow-up conversation and suggestions. Users keep asking in the same conversation and Copilot suggests follow-up questions. Responses are grounded and can include charts and tables. copilot chat ux charts

Default test handlers. Regular test handlers are declared by the test codeunit, while default handlers run on every test, including tests from other apps. They suit telemetry setup or running Microsoft test suites against your extension. al testing test-handlers telemetry enum
Updated data picker. The Word add-in data picker got UX improvements. It shows the company information data set next to report information. word-add-in reporting data-picker ux

E-document messages. A message architecture attaches messages such as acknowledgement and order response to the e-document. These messages are linked to the original document. e-documents edi messages
Sample layouts for themes. The Word add-in has sample documents to preview style, font and color changes. You then save, clear the content and upload as a theme. themes word-add-in layouts reporting

Composite layout menu on a body layout. On a body layout in the report layouts page, a composite layout menu lets you pick the theme and header footer for testing. Running the report then shows the chosen combination. reporting layouts themes ux
Export logs pushed to Fabric. Synchronization logs are also written into Fabric for monitoring through the SQL endpoint. fabric monitoring logs sql
Mileage rates per period. Mileage allowance can have start and end dates for several periods. The rate is picked based on the expense date. expense mileage setup expense-agent
Run BC-Bench on your own data set. Partners can fork the open-source repo and use their own bug fixes, tests and PRs. Contamination should be checked for open-source repos. agents testing partners al
Non-debuggable boundary audit. A query finds debuggable callees of non-debuggable methods, where a breakpoint could leak content. al security debugging auditing
Multi-company Power BI reporting. Multi-company app versions show data across companies with a company filter. power-bi multi-company fabric reporting

Invoicing for France. Invoicing for France is introduced with three new e-document formats set up on the e-document service, including e-reporting. Lifecycle events such as collected, submitted, accepted, refused and technical rejected are stored as messages linked to the invoice e-document. e-documents france compliance localization finance

AL code review approaches. BC-Bench compares plain Copilot CLI, BC Quality as a plug-in and the AL review agent. The review agent focuses on security, privacy and performance and already comments on BC apps PRs. code-review copilot agents al
Citations, progress messages and sources. Answers include clickable citation pills, progress messages and a sources button listing what the AI used. copilot citations trust ux

Test data source interface. An interface with one function to list test cases and one to build test context objects. Sources can be resource files, generated cases, tables or web services. testing al interfaces

Expense submission and approval on mobile. The mobile app supports submitting expense reports and the full approver experience. Approvers review expenses, check compliance flags, override them and approve. expense mobile approvals approval ux

Database export as an environment operation. An export appears on the operations page with status, times, who triggered it and the error on failure. It uses the same filters and details flyout as other operations. admin operations database-export ux

Company information data set. A company information data set is always shipped with Word layouts, so authors need not add it themselves. It is useful for header and footer layouts. word-layout report-dataset header-footer reporting
Project and task on a web app expense. In the web app a user selects a project and task on an expense. Only active projects and posting tasks are offered. expense projects web-app ux
Change propagation and synchronization log. Source changes show in the subsidiary after about a minute. Logs and job rescheduling work as for single-environment sync. mdm synchronization log ux
MCP server on/off toggle. A toggle on the Copilot and agent capabilities page activates or deactivates the MCP server as a whole. mcp admin security copilot

System fields in profiles. In the profile page designer, system fields can be found and added to a page. The example adds modified by to the sales order card for all profile users. profiles system-fields page-designer ux admin

Direct transfer mode and transit location on transfer routes. Transfer routes have fields for direct transfer mode and transit location. Defaults come from inventory posting setup and can be overridden. transfer-orders setup warehouse

Create transfer order to subcontractor. A Subcontracting action on the production order creates a transfer order to the subcontractor location. It holds lines for components and the transfer WIP item. subcontracting transfer-order manufacturing logistics

Agentic developer loop. The agent plans an investigation and uses ALSP, the AL tool proxy and the Business Central MCP server for call stacks, variables and CPU profiles. The loop is understand, capture, measure, fix. agents mcp al debugging architecture
Inventory pick for direct transfers. Outbound and inbound transfers can be posted together from an inventory pick, including partial quantities. transfer-orders warehouse inventory-pick
Automatic mileage amount calculation. The amount is filled from the date and vehicle type when creating a mileage expense. expense mileage expense-agent ux

Intent detection and agentic loop. Copilot detects intent from the message history and iterates through tools. Tools include Business Central, work data, other agents and the web. copilot agents tools architecture

Run migration by disabling legacy subcontracting. Disable legacy subcontracting runs the migration, restarts the session and switches application areas. Activation is blocked while unmigrated data exists. migration application-area italy manufacturing
Initial cross-environment synchronization. Start all runs default tables in a predefined order, starting with business relations and dimensions. mdm synchronization setup master-data

AL MCP server for coding agents. The AL MCP server exposes compile, publish and search to agents without VS Code. It improved pass@5 by almost 10% in BC-Bench at the cost of longer runs. mcp al agents vs-code

Ad valorem and hybrid excise calculation. Ad valorem calculates excise as a percent of a taxable amount. Hybrid combines a specific component with an ad valorem component. finance excise calculation taxes
Permission overview page in context. The permissions overview page can be opened from the permission sets list, the permission set card and the table information page. security permissions admin ux

Quality inspection assignment and role-based control. Changing a header field prompts self-assignment. Quality admin or supervisor roles can change quantities, reassign, reopen or delete finished inspections. quality permissions ux
Resolving vague item references. A short query like tell me about S100 is resolved to the matching item by Business Central tools. copilot tools inventory ux
Bookmarks in profiles. Bookmarked views can be added to a profile's role center for all its users. profiles bookmark role-center admin
Skipped record notification in price sync. Foreground price sync shows a notification when records are skipped, for example sales blocked items. shopify price-sync troubleshooting job-queue

Approval history in Business Central. The approval history is shown in the Business Central expense report and posted expense report. Accountants with rights can see it. expense audit approvals business-central
Provide feedback button. A provide feedback button lets users report problems with details and files to the Microsoft team only. shopify feedback admin ux

Operations page audit of PTE actions. The environment operations page captures every PTE install, update and scheduling action. Scheduled operations show a target app version and are reconciled to completed when the update starts. admin audit operations

Shipped themes, header footers and body layouts. Microsoft aims to ship themes (calm, default, playful, standard), about eight header footer layouts and around 50 body layouts. Header footers are split into external reports with logo and minimal internal ones, and samples are available for your own report objects. reporting layouts themes samples
AI change notification on sales document. A sales document created from a Shopify order shows a notification that the order was modified by AI. It opens the tax match review. shopify ai sales tax

Required pending attribute. An attribute tells interface consumers that implementing a new method will become mandatory in a later major. Consumers get a warning instead of a break. al interfaces attributes upgrade

Installing the Subcontracting app. The app replaces the legacy Subcontracting worksheet, which shows a notification with an install action. Upgraded environments can also install it from Microsoft Marketplace or AppSource in Business Central. subcontracting install worksheet appsource admin manufacturing
Address design control. A design block offers three address formats, such as sender, receiver and shipping address in three columns. word-layout design-blocks reporting body-layout

Subcontracting app replaces Italian subcontracting. Italian subcontracting is discontinued and replaced by the global Subcontracting app. One key difference is around work in progress items. subcontracting italy migration manufacturing
Free-text expense policies per category. Policies are free-text lines linked to expense categories, including custom ones. Each policy should be its own line. expense policies finance agents
Submit with policies pending. Submitters can submit with pending policies. The system evaluates them and routes to the approver. expense approvals approval agents finance
Report packs. A package defines a list of reports with filters and dates. Running it gives one PDF. reporting report-packs pdf finance
Foreign currency budgeting. A request can be budgeted in foreign currency and an action updates the local amount at travel time. expense currency budgeting

Feature switch for the new document experience. Feature management has a setting to enable or turn off the new document experience. This allows a gradual rollout of composite layouts per environment. admin feature-management rollout reporting
Synchronization overview and details logs. Overview and details logs are under monitoring with views for all, errors or pushed data. fabric monitoring logs admin

Purchase order e-document. When the buyer releases a purchase order, an e-document is generated in the background to send to the seller. It carries items, quantities and expected dates. e-documents edi purchase peppol

Mileage expenses on mobile. Users create a mileage expense on the phone by entering a destination, choosing a route and picking a vehicle type. Distance and rate are calculated as in the web app. expense mobile mileage ux

Default theme and header footer levels. Default theme and header footer can be set globally, per company, per report and per body layout. Each lower level overrides the one above it. reporting admin branding defaults

Project tracking in the Expense Agent. Projects can be used on expenses in the web app. The admin enables project tracking in the setup guide, otherwise the option does not show. expense projects setup web-app
Server features box in MCP configuration. The MCP configuration page separates server features from APIs and shows which system tools each feature enables. mcp admin ux
Update a PTE from the admin center. From the app details page you can install a different version of an installed PTE. This triggers an update rather than a new install. admin pte updates
HTTP client caller query. A query exports everything calling the HTTP client, excluding tests, as a call path tree. al http auditing call-graph

Fabric connection setup. A Fabric integration app holds the workspace and mirroring database setup. Connect to Fabric builds the infrastructure and test connection checks write access. fabric setup connection admin
Credit card reconciliation with expenses. Card records are matched to existing expenses or create new expenses awaiting receipts. expense credit-card reconciliation

Withholding posting groups on employee and expense category. The withholding business posting group goes on the employee card and the product posting group on the expense category. expense withholding-tax setup employees

Page scripting generally available. The page scripting tool moves from preview to general availability. It records and replays user actions in the web client, for example for user acceptance tests. page-scripting testing ga web-client

Work IQ data in Copilot. With the Microsoft Copilot license, Copilot also uses Work IQ data such as calendar, email, Teams and files. The demo finds a customer meeting in the user's calendar. copilot work-iq calendar licensing ux microsoft-365

EDI setup. Setup follows the invoicing pattern: e-document setup, vendors and customers set to exchange electronically, and electronic identifiers on both sides. Item reference or GTIN is recommended, and quantities and delivery dates should be filled. e-documents edi setup admin
Page context sent to Copilot. Copilot uses content from the current page, including extension pages, plus knowledge about the user such as role, as hints. copilot context extensions ux
Action inherits page tooltip. An action using RunObject no longer needs its own tooltip, because it comes from the target page. The description is kept in one place. al tooltip pages ux
Automatic revert after 72 hours. The environment reverts to a typical sandbox configuration after 72 hours. The revert happens in the first update window after that. admin sandbox update-window

Scan receipts with auto capture. From the plus button the user picks scan receipts and the phone's native auto capture grabs receipts automatically. Several receipts can be captured at once and are processed by the Expense Agent. expense mobile receipts ux agents

Subcontracting views on purchase and transfer orders. Legacy subcontracting pages are gone and migrated documents appear in normal lists with a subcontracting view. purchase transfer-orders migration ux
Interim approvers. An interim approver such as an accountant can check an expense report for compliance. They must approve before the final approver. expense approvals workflow
Minimum amount for subcontractor price. If the line amount is below the vendor minimum, the unit price becomes the minimum amount divided by quantity. subcontracting pricing manufacturing

Serial numbers at any level in subcontracting. Serial numbers can be defined on the production order or the purchase document. Any receiving method works. subcontracting item-tracking warehouse manufacturing

Mileage rates per vehicle type. Mileage rates can be set per vehicle type from a new table, combined with periods. The user picks the vehicle type on the mileage expense. expense mileage setup expense-agent
Bonded location for excise. A location can be marked so excise duty is not calculated on inbound receipt. Duty is calculated when goods leave the bonded location. finance excise location warehouse

Machine center calendar entries available until. The machine center card shows until when calendar entries exist, in red when missing. A calculate calendar report is added to the card. manufacturing capacity ux
Legacy subcontracting toggle. An Italy-only Manufacturing Setup field indicates legacy subcontracting. It is off on new environments and on for upgraded ones. manufacturing italy setup migration

Assigned resources on the project card. The project card has an Assigned resources section. All assigned resources see that project and its tasks in the web app. expense projects resources project-card
Change log for financial report definitions. Change log is set up automatically on financial report definition tables, auditing changes with user ID. change-log auditing finance admin
Travel request reference on expense report. The expense report specifies its travel request and shows actuals. expense travel-request expense-report posting

Tariff code sync. Tariff number and country from the item card are sent to Shopify as HS code and country of origin. A shop card toggle controls import and export. shopify tariff item-sync integration

Deprecation of in-environment PTE management. PTE management in the extension management pages and in the automation API will be deprecated as of version 30.0. Users should migrate to the admin center within about half a year and not mix both experiences in one environment. admin deprecation api pte

Header and footer authoring help. A new header footer layout comes with the company information data set. In Word you add default header or footer versions, modify and upload them. header-footer word-add-in layouts reporting
Self-billing number series per vendor. Each self-billing vendor can have its own number series. Otherwise the Payables setup series is used. finance self-billing number-series purchasing

Dev extensions remain installed on sandboxes. Dev extensions are treated more like PTEs and are not uninstalled during environment updates or other lifecycle operations unless incompatible. This reduces unexpected uninstalls and republishing. al sandbox extensions developer
Failed quality inspection blocks transfer. Posting a transfer is blocked for a tracked item with a failed inspection, and the error opens the inspection. quality transfer-orders item-tracking

EUDR certificate capture. A tab on the Lot No. Information card holds certificate number, schema, dates, DDS information and country for EUDR items. It can also be used for other schemas such as FSC. sustainability eudr lot-tracking certificates certification
AL graph meta model extraction. An extract subcommand builds a JSON meta model of caller-callee relationships once. Later queries run against it. al call-graph cli performance
Audit link between G/L entries and travel request. Posted G/L entries link to the travel request so auditors see who authorized the spend. expense audit ledger-entries finance
Telemetry for Open in Excel. A telemetry signal records who used Open in Excel and when. telemetry security excel admin

Connecting to the snapshot debugging MCP server. Connect through the AL tool as MCP host, Visual Studio Code via launch.json starting the snapshot MCP proxy, or your own MCP host. mcp vs-code launch-json setup al
Copilot and agent capabilities admin control. The Copilot and agent capabilities page lets admins opt in or out of AI features and control who can use them. admin copilot governance agents

No blank-location inventory posting setup. Inventory posting setup entries with empty location are no longer needed. Transit locations are used and location code is always filled on manufacturing value entries. setup posting inventory manufacturing
Table builder editing. The table builder can edit an existing table definition through the wizard, not only insert tables. word-add-in table-builder reporting ux
Feedback on Copilot responses. Users can give thumbs up or down and share screenshots and prompts to help troubleshoot unexpected results. copilot feedback ux telemetry

Project visibility: all or assigned projects. A setup option decides whether users see all projects or only those they are assigned to. Assigned projects helps with many projects or hidden projects. expense projects setup admin

Manage themes and header footer layouts page. From the manage themes and header footer layouts page you can create a new theme or header footer layout with a name and description. You either start blank or upload an existing layout, which then becomes available for use. reporting admin themes header-footer word branding
Approval limits. An approver can have a maximum approval amount alongside an unlimited approver. One specific-amount level plus an unlimited level is supported. expense approvals limits admin

TaxMatch fact box and agent settings. A fact box on the Shopify shop card holds settings to activate the TaxMatch agent, allow creating tax jurisdictions and areas, and set a prefix for created tax areas. shopify agents tax admin
MCP server landing page. The Business Central MCP server has its own session and a landing page at aka.ms/bcmcp. mcp docs agents

Find mapping by barcode toggle. A hidden field controls fallback to barcode search when SKU mapping fails. Disabling it avoids duplicate variant links but requires manual mapping. shopify item-mapping barcode admin
Test handler registration via enum extensions. Handlers are registered by extending the test handler enum for opt-in or the default test handler enum for global. testing al enums

Match production configuration. Administrators can temporarily match a sandbox database configuration to a typical production database. This helps evaluate production behavior, for example for performance work or cloud migration. admin sandbox performance cloud-migration
Hide if control. A content control hides or shows its content based on a chosen boolean value. word-layout conditional reporting body-layout
Skipping test cases with test handlers. Handlers can skip test cases, for example AI tests once a monthly token limit is exceeded. testing ai al performance
Mirrored data with SQL endpoint. Tables are stored as Delta Parquet files in the mirroring database. The SQL endpoint allows normal SQL queries. fabric onelake sql delta-parquet

Uncategorized accounts views. Two saved views on the chart of accounts show accounts without category or subcategory. This helps explain missing financial report data. finance chart-of-accounts reporting ux

Database export reliability. The most common failures were removed across the export pipeline, so fewer than 1% of exports fail. Big environments can be exported reliably. admin database-export reliability performance
Multiple excise taxes per item. The excise fast tab on the item card is replaced by an Excise Taxes page under Related. One item can have several excise taxes. finance excise items upgrade ux
Travel request lines with currency. Requests can be itemized with foreign amounts translated to local currency, plus schedule and locations. expense travel-request currency

Export history API endpoint deprecated. The admin center API export history endpoint is deprecated and kept only on API versions 2.29 and earlier. Automations should move to the environment operations API. api admin deprecation automation

Subcontracting components on the production order. On a refreshed released production order, subcontracting components get different location codes. Transfer components point to the main location and others to the vendor card location. subcontracting production-order components locations
B2B company synchronization by default. B2B company synchronization is visible by default. Adding a company creates the company, a customer and a catalog on Shopify. shopify b2b company-sync
Withholding tax group. A category can use a tax group holding several product posting groups with a component order for calculation. expense withholding-tax tax-group setup

E-document types and directions. Four e-document types are covered: purchase order, sales order, order response and remittance advice. Each type can be set to inbound only, outbound only or both. e-documents edi setup admin

Deployment schedules for PTE installs. When installing a PTE you can choose immediate, next minor update or next major update, plus a sync mode. Previously in-product installs could only be immediate. admin pte scheduling updates
App view filter for per tenant extensions. The apps page can be filtered to show different views of installed apps, for example only per tenant extensions. admin ux extensions
Copilot respects user permissions. Copilot runs as the signed-in user and accesses data only within their permissions. copilot permissions security admin
Get next object ID tool. An MCP tool reads app.json, works out the ID ranges and suggests free object IDs. In the demo it skipped IDs already in use. mcp al object-ids copilot

Upload receipts from gallery or files. Existing receipt pictures can be sent to the Expense Agent from the gallery with the operating system share function. The plus menu also offers choose from files. expense mobile receipts ux agents

Tax match review mode setting. Users choose to review matches always, never or only on low confidence. Review cannot be skipped for significant issues such as a missing jurisdiction or different tax rate. shopify ai tax admin

Create subcontracting order from routing. A subcontracting purchase order can be created from the production order routing with one action. The worksheet remains for bulk operations. subcontracting purchase-order routing manufacturing
Automatic passed and failed quantity. Finishing an inspection moves the sample size to passed or failed quantity, usable in workflows. quality workflows
Streaming Open in Excel. Open in Excel uses a streaming implementation with less memory and fewer out of memory exceptions. Larger files can be loaded. excel performance runtime al
Field group design control. A design block for label and value pairs as a column grid, single or double stacked. It will be used in new body layouts. word-layout design-blocks reporting body-layout
TestHandlers property. A test codeunit property takes a comma-separated list of handlers. A codeunit can implement the interface and register itself. testing al properties
Gross, net or gross up calculation base. The calculation base can be gross, net or gross up. expense withholding-tax calculation setup
Employee withholding exemption and certificate. A posting group can mark an employee exempt. Optional certificate number and type fields exist. expense withholding-tax employees setup
Ad hoc alternate approver. An approver can delegate pending expense reports to a colleague. All pending reports are redirected. expense approvals delegation

Subcontracting FastTab in Manufacturing setup. Manufacturing setup gets a Subcontracting FastTab with a Create production order info line toggle. It also holds a component transfer lead time. subcontracting setup manufacturing admin
Data-driven tests in Test Explorer. After one run, all test cases appear in the VS Code Test Explorer. Running selections and debugging work as usual. testing vs-code debugging
Configuration packages for Fabric tables. Configuration packages define tables to synchronize, for example for the Power BI apps. ISVs can ship their own package. fabric isv configuration partner
Pull-based incremental synchronization. HQ stays read-only and subsidiaries pull only the changes across environments. mdm synchronization incremental integration
Totaling fact box on row definitions. A fact box on row definition lines shows the G/L accounts in the totaling filter, with navigation. finance row-definitions reporting ux

Command line test run with JSON output. The whole test suite can be run from the command line. It returns structured JSON with pass, fail and skip counts and a real exit code, so failures fail the build. al testing ci json pipeline

Project ledger entries from expense reports. The chosen project and task show in the billable information of the expense report. Posting creates project ledger entries automatically. expense projects posting finance
Test preview for row and column definitions. A default counterpart definition can be set for testing, and a test button shows the full report. finance reporting preview ux
Emissions on fixed assets. FA journals show sustainability account and CO2, and reclassification splits emissions by a CO2 percentage. sustainability fixed-assets journals finance

Themes and header footer layouts from AL. In the rendering section of a report you specify type Word with subtype Theme or Header Footer, while body layouts use subtype Body. Themes use a Word template file. al reporting word rendering
Enable and disable keys at runtime. A key can be defined with Enabled set to false and enabled by code at runtime. This suits features most customers do not use. al indexes database performance

Guidance for Copilot-friendly extensions. A Microsoft Learn article gives guidelines for building extensions that Copilot and agents can work with more easily, for example more descriptive ones. isv extensions copilot al
EUDR fields on the item card. The item card Sustainability tab gets EUDR relevant and EUDR commodity fields. Item tracking is needed for these items. sustainability eudr item-card item-tracking
Standard mileage rate. The standard rate setup still works. If filled, the new rate setup is not used. expense mileage setup expense-agent
Permission set for HQ read access. A purpose-designed permission set with read access to default tables is assigned to the app user in the source. permissions security mdm admin
Policies pending after changes. Changing merchant or description resets the status to policies pending until re-evaluated. expense policies agents ux
Customer meeting sales brief. Copilot prepares a sales brief from customer data with sales figures, momentum, account risk and talking points. copilot sales customers chat
Table and company selection for Fabric. You choose which tables and companies to synchronize, then start synchronization. fabric configuration tables companies
Offline mode. Without a connection users can still add receipts to the app. They are uploaded and processed when the phone is back online. expense mobile offline ux
Actionable error on refresh production order. When refresh fails because the routing is not certified, the error explains why and opens the routing. manufacturing routing errors ux
Dynamic previous and next operations in routings. Previous and next operation fields are visible for parallel routings and hidden for serial ones. manufacturing routing ux
ITestHandler interface. The interface offers before and after hooks at codeunit, procedure and test case level. All have default implementations. testing al interfaces
Where-used for G/L accounts in financial reports. Where-used on the account card shows which financial report definitions use the account. finance where-used reporting ux
Recent records virtual table. The recent records list is exposed to AL as a queryable virtual table. Records can be deleted, otherwise it is read only. al virtual-table runtime ux
Contact numbers on Shopify orders. Sell-to, bill-to and ship-to contact numbers can be shown on Shopify orders. They are filled automatically and can be changed. shopify orders contacts ux
Migration from test toolkit events to test handlers. Test handlers are separate from the test toolkit events. Users of those events must migrate to get the new functionality. testing al migration
Withholding at invoice or payment. Withholding is calculated on expense report posting or on payment, staying unrealized until paid. expense withholding-tax posting setup
Credit card statement upload. Uploaded statements are processed and kept as credit card feed records. expense credit-card import

Override of layout description. For layouts shipped from an app, the developer's description can be overridden by an administrator. The override shows on the report layout page and in the user's view of it. reporting layouts admin al

US-only TaxMatch extension. The capability is a small US-only Shopify extension not published on AppSource. It is installed by default on new installations based on localization or offered as a prompt on upgrade. shopify extension tax admin
Planned alternate approver. An approver plans an alternate for a date range. Expense reports are redirected automatically in that period. expense approvals delegation workflow
Travel request approval. Approval is added for travel requests. The request shows who approved it and when. expense approvals travel-request travel
Verifactu in Spain. Verifactu enablement in Spain is generally available. It needs setup, and is on AppSource if uninstalled. finance localization spain compliance

Warehouse, price and cost for subcontracting. Subcontracting operations can use standard warehouse processes. More price management and cost allocation are mentioned. subcontracting warehouse pricing cost
Migrated vendor fields and subcontracting prices. Vendor subcontracting fields are migrated and the work center link stays. Prices move to the new table. vendors pricing migration manufacturing

Boolean expressions for Hide if. Later you will set a boolean expression on data set values to hide or show content. A small formula language will be part of it. word-layout conditional formula reporting
Unlisted product status. The connector supports Shopify's unlisted status, sold by direct link but hidden in the store. shopify item-sync status
Notes design control. The notes control asks how many bullet points you want and adds the component. word-layout design-blocks reporting body-layout
Skipped records and API errors in the role center. The Shopify activities part shows counts of skipped records and API errors across stores. shopify role-center ux admin
BC-Bench bug fixing category. Agents fix bugs in the real codebase across 101 tasks from bugs human engineers fixed. al testing agents

Components at vendor location field. A vendor card field tracks components still owned by the company at the vendor location. It shows consignment and vendor supplied components. subcontracting vendor inventory ux

Admin center API for PTE operations. Endpoints for all demoed PTE operations are available in the admin center API. S2S apps used by partners do not need in-environment registration and permission sets to upload and install PTEs. api admin automation partners
Reporting features pointer. Reporting has three separate videos and is only pointed to in the server session. reporting
EUDR flag on purchase lines. Purchase orders and receipts get a line-level EUDR flag. sustainability eudr purchase supply-chain
Totaling fact box on column definitions. The same G/L accounts fact box is on column definitions with totaling. finance column-definitions reporting ux
Travel requests in web and phone app. Travel requests will come to the web and phone apps but were not ready at recording. expense mobile travel-request ux agents

Shopify Tax Matching. An AI capability analyzes tax information received with Shopify orders and tries to match it to Business Central tax setup. If no match is found, it creates the missing information. shopify ai tax agents finance
Agents generating page scripts. Agents can be used to try to generate page scripts and run them. page-scripting agents testing copilot

Subcontracting fact box on purchase lines. A fact box on the purchase line shows the connected production order. It links to production orders, transfer orders, routings and components. subcontracting purchase-order factbox ux
Line type defaulting in definitions. New lines in row or column definitions default to the type of the previous lines. finance reporting ux
API overview page. A new API overview page, shipping in version 29, is the easiest way to find APIs. Searching there shows API names and URLs to try them out. api discoverability admin
Agent harness comparison. With the same model, GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code showed no significant difference. Model choice matters more. agents testing al

Automatic categorization into expense reports. After upload, the agent recognizes expenses and sorts them into expense reports. In the demo it matched a receipt to an existing report and created new reports for the others. expense agents mobile copilot
Fabric integration APIs. Setup and monitoring data are available as six APIs listed on the API overview page. api fabric automation monitoring

Order response. The seller can accept or reject the order and send a response back. The buyer imports it and it is linked to the original purchase order e-document with a status. e-documents edi sales purchase
Resources on project tasks. Users can be assigned to individual project task lines instead of the whole project. They then pick only their assigned tasks. expense projects tasks resources

Single Export database button. Export database is now one button instead of a dropdown with export history. The flyout notes that progress can be tracked on the operations page. admin ux database-export
Side-by-side data view. Data Copilot finds can be opened side by side with the chat while the conversation continues. copilot ux chat sales
Certification details on sales invoice. The sales invoice layout can print the lot, certification schema and certification number. sustainability eudr invoice layout sales
Entra app registration and consent. An Entra app with API read/write all permissions is registered and the HQ admin gives consent in Business Central. entra oauth security admin
Cross-environment setup wizard. A wizard collects privacy consent, the HQ environment and company, and the app client ID and secret, stored securely. wizard setup mdm security
Policy check availability rules. The check is unavailable without policies or when the report is unchanged since the last evaluation. expense policies agents ux

E-document linkage from documents. Users can open the created e-document straight from the purchase order via the fact box. Response messages are also visible directly from the document. e-documents edi ux
Validate message and error dialog text. A recording can validate the text of a message or error dialog. This turns a recording into a real assertion. page-scripting assertions testing error-messages
Subcontracting assisted setup. An assisted setup fills in default values, lets you change them and links to related pages. subcontracting setup admin

Automatic expense report from travel request. Requests made in the Expense Agent create the expense report automatically. In Business Central it is created manually. expense travel-request automation agents expense-report
Sustainability formulas on purchase documents. Formulas from journals can be used on purchase orders and invoices, with recalculation on change. sustainability formulas purchase ux

Remittance advice from payment journal. After posting the purchase invoice and applying a payment in the payment journal, the buyer can send a remittance advice file to the seller through the e-document service. e-documents edi payments finance
Database export history page retirement. The database export history page is retiring. Its information, plus more, is on the operations page. admin deprecation database-export
Currency code on mileage rates. Mileage rates have an optional currency code field. expense mileage currency expense-agent setup
Strongly typed test context. The data source returns an ITestContext, but the test can use its own interface for typed test data. testing al interfaces
Permission sets for Fabric integration. Permission sets cover activation, administration and read-only configuration access. permissions fabric security admin
Receipt itemization. More receipt itemization is planned so AI can evaluate policies such as alcohol in a meal. expense receipts copilot agents

Page scripting localization. Every user-facing string in page scripting is translated, including steps, error messages and tooltips. This makes the tool ready for production use in all languages. page-scripting localization ux
Resource link on the employee card. Each employee needs a resource selected on the employee card. The system then recognizes the user in expense management. expense employee resources setup
Match production in admin center API. The match production configuration operation is supported in the admin center APIs. Developers can automate it in their processes. api admin automation
AI Test Toolkit migration to data-driven tests. AI Test Toolkit data-driven tests do not use the new system yet and cannot run from VS Code. Migration is planned. testing ai vs-code
Approval messaging. Approve and reject actions show different messages, icons and colors. expense approvals ux
Order traceability by EUDR batch. With item tracking you can see which orders used batches with EUDR information. sustainability eudr traceability item-tracking
DGML and SARIF export. Results export as DGML for humans or SARIF for agents. al export agents call-graph
Pictures and attachments sync. Pictures and attachments travel with the synchronized record. mdm attachments pictures limits
Reverse sustainability ledger entries. A reverse button works like for G/L entries, for multiple entries, with reversed and reversed-by columns. sustainability reversal ledger-entries ux
Refreshed Expense Agent web app. The web app has a refreshed user experience. expense ux web-app
Signature line design control. A signature line block with two types and custom captions. It is used in quality management. word-layout design-blocks reporting body-layout quality-management
Expense Agent worldwide availability. Expense Agent will roll out gradually to all countries starting in October. expense availability admin
Shared or per-subsidiary app registration. One app can be shared across subsidiaries or one registered per subsidiary, depending on audit needs. entra security audit admin
Scheduling report packs. Report packs can be scheduled and land in the report inbox. reporting scheduling report-inbox finance
Finding sustainability entries. Sustainability entries can be found like other entries. sustainability navigation ux
Match production operation tracking. The operation can be tracked like other admin center operations. Details show who started it and when. admin operations sandbox
Simple or compound withholding calculation. With several taxes you choose simple or compound calculation. expense withholding-tax calculation setup
Mandatory override reason. Approvers will need a reason to override a policy, kept in audit records. expense approvals audit approval finance
AL graph query language. A query language supports complex queries such as all callers of an object or methods touching a table. It is documented on MS Learn. al query call-graph documentation
EU BP file export for Germany. EU BP files can be exported with the audit file export in the German localization. finance localization germany audit-file
Match production usage limit. The operation is limited to three occurrences per tenant per calendar month, each lasting 72 hours. admin limits sandbox
Self-billing PEPPOL format. A PEPPOL format is added for self-billing. Self-billing becomes part of the e-documents framework. e-documents peppol self-billing
Approver override of policy flags. Policies are guidance and approvers can still approve flagged expenses. expense approvals policies approval finance

Value chain emissions in more documents. Value chain emissions are available in item, item reclassification and FA reclassification journals and service management. sustainability value-chain journals service
Scope 3 tracking by item tracking. The item card sets average or specific method so lots or serials carry their own emissions. sustainability scope-3 item-tracking lot

Sales order from inbound e-document. On the seller side, importing the purchase order XML in the inbound e-document list with the PEPPOL format creates a sales order automatically. Dates, items, quantities and amounts are carried over. e-documents edi sales peppol

Automatic creation of tax jurisdictions and tax areas. When no match exists, new tax jurisdictions, a tax area and sometimes tax details are created. The demo created a tax area with three new jurisdictions. shopify ai tax finance
Payment times for Australia and Great Britain. Payment times rules are expanded for Australia and Great Britain. finance localization australia uk
Amounts design control. A design block that shows calculations with captions and values. It does not calculate anything. word-layout design-blocks reporting body-layout
Data-driven tests via AL tool and AL MCP. Data-driven tests can also run through the AL tool and the AL MCP. testing mcp al
Collect Amount from GL remembers posted amounts. Collect amount from GL suggests only the part not yet posted. sustainability general-ledger posting finance
Page scripting accessibility and usability. An accessibility and usability pass was made on page scripting, with look and feel changes based on feedback. page-scripting accessibility ux
Standard task codes. Standard task codes are included to demonstrate different subcontractor pricing. subcontracting pricing demo-data manufacturing
NST on .NET 10. The Business Central service tier now runs on .NET 10. runtime dotnet performance admin
Withholding thresholds. Thresholds can be per line, document, category per period or total in period, with month, quarter, year or fiscal periods. expense withholding-tax threshold setup
Travelers on a travel request. A list of other travelers can be added to the request. expense travel-request
Restart warning flyout. The admin center button opens a flyout explaining the action and warning that the environment restarts. Connected users are disconnected. admin sandbox restart

Automatic upgrade of excise configuration. Existing excise configuration from the previous wave is upgraded automatically to the new table and page. No manual action is needed. finance excise upgrade admin
Transfer entry type in excise permission. Excise permission supports the transfer entry type besides sales, purchase and manufacturing. finance excise transfer

Intrastat for Germany and QR invoicing address for Switzerland. New Intrastat reporting in Germany based on Intrastat core. Fully structured address support for QR invoicing in Switzerland. finance localization germany switzerland
New languages for Expense Agent. Czech, Dutch, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian and Swedish will be added to the five current languages. expense languages availability
Multiple selection in grids. Recordings can capture selecting several rows in a list and running bulk actions on them. These steps can be replayed. page-scripting grids testing ux
Read isolation for isolated storage. Read isolation is an explicit option when reading from isolated storage. You can state read committed with an update lock. al isolated-storage locking
SFT in Austria and Iceland. Existing SFT functionality is enabled for the Austria and Iceland localizations. finance localization austria iceland
ESG report per lot. The ESG report layout can print information per lot. sustainability reporting esg lot
Match production paid license requirement. The feature is only available on tenants with a paid license type. This includes partners using the partner sandbox license. licensing admin partner
